g_AiCombatTargetSourceCounterCountWeight: int32_t weight 0x20000 for the source class counter term of the AI combat target score (gameplay/ai/combat.c)

g_AppActive: uint32_t: WM_ACTIVATEAPP wParam (application active flag), initially 1; platform/bootstrap/runtime.c
g_ArmyPreviewAlphaPremultiplyMmxLut256: uint64_t[256] MMX qword per alpha a: three 16-bit lanes (a * 0x101) >> 4, alpha lane 0; PMULHW premultiply of the 2x2 downsample in the army preview (gameplay/army/runtime.c)
g_ArmyPreviewAverageAlphaReciprocalMmxLu: uint64_t[256] MMX qword per average alpha a: three lanes ~0x3FF0/a (reciprocal), fourth lane a; un-premultiplies the averaged army preview pixel (gameplay/army/runtime.c)
g_ArmyRuntimeDepthBinClassByModelClass: uint32_t[24] depth-bin/occupancy class per model runtime class (0x88/0x90/0xA0/0xC0; 0x90 = structure), copied to ArmyRuntimeSlot.depthBinClass; gameplay/army runtime and placement
g_DebugOverlayCounterRefreshCountdown: uint32_t: frames until the debug overlay counters refresh (reloaded with 20); ui/ingame and ui/frontend runtime
g_Direct3DTextureFilterMode: uint32_t: D3DRENDERSTATE_TEXTUREMAG/MIN filter (2 = D3DFILTER_LINEAR) reapplied by the device setup; graphics/backend direct3d/directdraw
g_Direct3DTexturePerspectiveEnabled: uint32_t: D3DRENDERSTATE_TEXTUREPERSPECTIVE value (1) reapplied by the device setup; graphics/backend direct3d/directdraw
g_FactionEnergyAllocationPriorityByModel: uint32_t[24] energy allocation priority per model runtime class (0 = none, up to 0x12); gameplay/session/runtime.c energy distribution
g_FileSystemConfigCharacterNormalization: uint8_t[256] byte map applied to every non-separator character of the file-system config text in FileSystem_Init: identity except a-z -> A-Z and the CP437 lowercase accented letters -> their uppercase forms (case folding).
g_FrontendMissionBriefingLevelDigitsUtf1: uint16_t[9] L"0000.flm" plus terminator: tail of the briefing movie path; the four digits are overwritten with the level number (ui/frontend/scenario.c)
g_FrontendMissionBriefingMoviePathUtf16: uint16_t[7] L"flm\\lev" without terminator: first half of the mission briefing movie path flm\lev0000.flm, continued by g_FrontendMissionBriefingLevelDigitsUtf16; opened with Movie_Open (ui/frontend/scenario.c)
g_FrontendSelectedPlayerToken: uint32_t sender context of the last executed network batch (0xFFFFFFFF = none); network/backend and protocol/transfer
g_GlideEnumerationResolutionQuery: GrResolution: grQueryResolutions template {GR_QUERY_ANY, GR_QUERY_ANY, 2 colour buffers, 1 aux buffer} for enumerating modes; Glide3_InitAndEnumerate
g_GlideRefreshRatesHz: uint32_t[9]: Hz per GR_REFRESH_* code (60,70,72,75,80,90,100,85,120); graphics/backend/glide.c
g_GlideSelectedResolutionQuery: GrResolution: grQueryResolutions template {resolution set at run time, GR_QUERY_ANY refresh, 2, 1} to pick the best refresh rate; GraphicsGlide3_ApplyDisplayModeAndInitializeResources
g_GlideTextureInfo256Argb4444: GlideTextureInfo (GrTexInfo): {LOD 8, LOD 8, aspect 1:1, GR_TEXFMT_ARGB_4444, NULL}; not referenced by address
g_GlideTextureRefreshHandlers: void *[3]: pointers to the GrVertex records g_GlideVertex0/1/2; no code reads it (name is historical)
g_GraphicsCursorAnimationCountdown: uint32_t ticks until the next cursor animation frame (initial 2, reloaded with 2 when it reaches 0 in graphics/core/runtime.c).
g_GraphicsShadingNearbyRecordCount: GraphicsShadingRecordCount (4 bytes, 0 in the image): number of valid g_GraphicsShadingNearbyRecords, set by GraphicsShadingRuntime_CollectNearbyRecords, read by the model vertex lighting. Followed by 8 bytes of 0x90 filler and g_ModelDistanceAttenuationMmxNegativeRows.
g_InGamePointerModeCommandIds: uint32_t[8]: command id per pointer mode (modifier mask & variant mask); gameplay/input/world.c
g_InGamePointerModePreviewArmyIds: uint32_t[8]: preview army asset id per pointer mode (0 = none); gameplay/input/world.c
g_InGameTechnologyCostRichText: uint16_t[25] rich-text stream: [0] command unit 0x8006 (RICHTEXT_OP_LITERAL_COLOR), [1..8] its colour digits, [9..24] the xenite cost text; patched in as payload 0 of the technology label (ui/ingame/technology.c)
g_InstallRegistryValueDataCapacityBytes: uint32_t: RegQueryValueExA lpcbData for the install "CD" value, initially 256 (size of g_InstallRegistryValueDataA); platform/bootstrap/runtime.c
g_LocaleMapTelephoneCountryCodeToRegionT: Function-pointer slot at 0x004027B0 statically holding Locale_MapTelephoneCountryCodeToRegionTagPacked (telephone country code -> packed ASCII region tag); sits between g_LocaleGetDefaultTelephoneCountryCode and g_LocaleCopyDefaultComputerLabelUtf16, no code reference to the slot found.
g_ModelDistanceAttenuationMmxNegativeRow: SoftwareBgraWordLanes[136]: rows -136..-1 of g_ModelDistanceAttenuationMmx, which ModelRender_ComputeVertexIntensityDefaultPath indexes with the signed light-facing dot >> 21; B/G/R lanes 0x007F (row -1) rising by 0x80 to 0x3F7F, then 0x3FFF, alpha lane 0x4000; PMULHW multipliers.
g_ModelLightingScaleMmxMultiplierTable: SoftwareBgraWordLanes[137]: PMULHW multipliers for ModelRender_ComputeVertexIntensityScaledPath, indexed by (dot / lightingScaleQ12) >> 9 (signed; negative rows fall into g_ModelDistanceAttenuationMmx before it); B/G/R lanes 0x1FFF at row 0 falling by 0x80 to 0x007F, then 0, alpha lane 0x4000.
g_ModelTraversalClass4SecondaryThreshold: uint32_t[3] traversal secondary thresholds 14000/15000/15500 for model definitions with placement contact kind 4, indexed by terrainTraversalClass - 1 (ModelDefinition resolve in assets/model/definitions.c)
g_ModelTraversalFallbackSecondaryThresho: uint32_t[3] traversal secondary thresholds 12500/13500/14500 for the other contact kinds, indexed by terrainTraversalClass - 4 (assets/model/definitions.c); followed by 12 bytes of 0x90 padding
g_NetworkFallbackSocketOptionOn: uint32_t: nonzero value (0xFFFFFFFF) passed to setsockopt(SO_BROADCAST) and ioctlsocket(FIONBIO); network/backend/fallback_udp.c
g_UiTransferEncryptSbox0: Encryption S-box 0 of the UI transfer 64-bit block cipher (UiTransfer_EncryptPacketBlocks): uint32_t[16][16], row = round-key nibble 0, column = data nibble 0, each entry a 4-bit output (each row a permutation of 0..15). The eight tables 0..7 are contiguous 0x00403160-0x00405160.
g_UiTransferEncryptSbox1: Encryption S-box 1 of the UI transfer block cipher: uint32_t[16][16], row = round-key nibble 1, column = data nibble 1, 4-bit outputs; used by UiTransfer_EncryptPacketBlocks.
g_UiTransferEncryptSbox2: Encryption S-box 2 of the UI transfer block cipher: uint32_t[16][16], row = round-key nibble 2, column = data nibble 2, 4-bit outputs; used by UiTransfer_EncryptPacketBlocks.
g_UiTransferEncryptSbox3: Encryption S-box 3 of the UI transfer block cipher: uint32_t[16][16], row = round-key nibble 3, column = data nibble 3, 4-bit outputs; used by UiTransfer_EncryptPacketBlocks.
g_UiTransferEncryptSbox4: Encryption S-box 4 of the UI transfer block cipher: uint32_t[16][16], row = round-key nibble 4, column = data nibble 4, 4-bit outputs; used by UiTransfer_EncryptPacketBlocks.
g_UiTransferEncryptSbox5: Encryption S-box 5 of the UI transfer block cipher: uint32_t[16][16], row = round-key nibble 5, column = data nibble 5, 4-bit outputs; used by UiTransfer_EncryptPacketBlocks. k_SpatialSoundStereoCosineSecondHalfBaseBias is only an address inside it (+0x140).
g_UiTransferEncryptSbox6: Encryption S-box 6 of the UI transfer block cipher: uint32_t[16][16], row = round-key nibble 6, column = data nibble 6, 4-bit outputs; used by UiTransfer_EncryptPacketBlocks.
g_UiTransferEncryptSbox7: Encryption S-box 7 of the UI transfer block cipher: uint32_t[16][16], row = round-key nibble 7, column = data nibble 7, 4-bit outputs; used by UiTransfer_EncryptPacketBlocks.
g_RichTextColorPalette0Argb: PackedArgb32 rich-text colour palette entry 0 (0xFFB0B0B0 grey); the palette is indexed by the 3-bit palette field of the packed text style (richtext.c) and set by RICHTEXT_OP_COLOR_PALETTE_0; also the normal cost colour of the technology panel.
g_RichTextColorPalette1Argb: PackedArgb32 rich-text colour palette entry 1 (0xFFE0E0E0 light grey), RICHTEXT_OP_COLOR_PALETTE_1.
g_RichTextColorPalette2Argb: PackedArgb32 rich-text colour palette entry 2 (0xFF707070 dark grey), RICHTEXT_OP_COLOR_PALETTE_2.
g_RichTextColorPalette3Argb: PackedArgb32 rich-text colour palette entry 3 (0xFFE0E0E0 light grey), RICHTEXT_OP_COLOR_PALETTE_3.
g_RichTextColorPalette4Argb: PackedArgb32 rich-text colour palette entry 4 (0xFF209020 green); only reachable through the packed text style's palette index, no direct code reference.
g_RichTextInsufficientResourceColorArgb: PackedArgb32 red (0xFFF02020) for technology costs the player cannot afford (ui/ingame/technology.c); also rich-text palette entry 5 by position.
g_RichTextShadowOffsetPalette0: uint32_t text shadow offset in pixels for colour palette entry 0 (2); indexed like the colour palette.
g_RichTextShadowOffsetPalette1: uint32_t text shadow offset in pixels for colour palette entry 1 (2).
g_RichTextShadowOffsetPalette2: uint32_t text shadow offset in pixels for colour palette entry 2 (1).
g_RichTextShadowOffsetPalette3: uint32_t text shadow offset in pixels for colour palette entry 3 (2).
g_SelectionPanelNumberTextStyle: UiPackedTextStyle 0x01000000 (font 1, palette 0, left aligned) used to measure and draw the numbers in the selection panel (gameplay/selection/runtime.c)
g_SessionNetworkTickInterval: uint32_t network lockstep interval in simulation steps (2 * the frontend speed slider value); sent in the join ack
g_SoftwareBilinearPackedInterpolationWei: int16_t[256][4] MMX word lanes per 8-bit fraction f: lane0 = 0x4040 - 0x40*f, lane1 = 0x40*f (sum 0x4040), lanes 2/3 zero; PMADDWD horizontal weights of SoftwareTexture_SampleIntensity (graphics/backend/software.c)
g_TerrainAuxHeightMinimum: int32_t minimum (triangle1NormalAngles >> 16) for the auxiliary height/placement scans in world/terrain/height.c (0x3000)
g_TerrainUnreferencedValue00503B04: int32_t 0x2000 directly after g_TerrainAuxHeightMinimum; no code reference found; followed by 0x90 fill
g_UiAction1012SubresourceByState: uint32_t[11]: sprite subresource index (0xA9..0xAB) of the diplomacy row's relation icon per relation state; ui/ingame/runtime.c
g_UiCommandModeGColorVariantFlags: uint32_t render-state flag word copied into terrain packets (primitives.c); ui/ingame/commands.c sets/clears the masked G-colour variant bit
g_UiCommandModeGColorVariantLimit: uint32_t ARGB mask applied to terrain vertex diffuse colours (0x00FFFFFF raw, other value in masked command mode); its alpha byte also switches overlay/projection paths
g_UiCommandModeGPrimaryPageIndices: uint32_t[6]: active page of the mode preview page stack per command mode G; ui/ingame commands/runtime
g_UiCommandModeGSecondaryPageIndices: uint32_t[6]: active page of the mode detail page stack per command mode G; ui/ingame commands/runtime
g_UiCommandModeGTertiaryPageIndices: uint32_t[6]: active page of the mode command page stack per command mode G; ui/ingame commands/runtime
g_UiHorizontalGaugeLabelTopInset: int32_t, 4: pixels from the gauge top to its label line (src/ui/controls/layout.c).
g_UiListActivationPulseFrames: UiFrameDelayFrames, 8: frames of the activation pulse after Enter on a list/text list before its action is queued (src/ui/controls/lists.c, text.c).
g_UiRangeSliderDragScale: int32_t, 1: multiplier of wheelDelta * stepValue when the mouse wheel moves a range slider (src/ui/controls/input.c).
g_UiResizableWindowTitleTextStyle: UiPackedTextStyle, 2: packed rich-text style of the resizable window title (src/ui/controls/layout.c).
g_UiResizableWindowTitleTextTopOffset: int32_t, 5: pixels from the window top to the title text line of a resizable window (src/ui/controls/layout.c).
g_UiScrollWheelDefaultStep: int32_t, 14: pixels scrolled per mouse-wheel step in a scrollable control whose child is not a list (UiScrollableControl wheel handler, src/ui/controls/lists.c).
g_UiScrollWheelListStep: int32_t, 15: pixels per mouse-wheel step when the scrollable control's child is a list/text list/timed list control (src/ui/controls/lists.c).
g_UiTextEditCaretBlinkPhaseStep: UiFrameDelayFrames, 8: frames per caret blink phase of a focused text edit, reloaded into the counter byte of editStateFlags (src/ui/controls/text.c).
g_UiTextStyleDisabled: UiPackedTextStyle, 0x20000 (palette byte 2): text style of disabled items (src/ui/controls/text.c).
g_UiTextStyleSelected: UiPackedTextStyle, 0x10000 (palette byte 1): text style of the selected/highlighted row or item (src/ui/controls/text.c).
g_UiTransferDecryptSboxes: Decryption S-boxes of the UI transfer block cipher: uint32_t[8][16][16], table n indexed [round-key nibble n][data nibble], 4-bit outputs (a separate table set from g_UiTransferEncryptSbox0..7); used by UiTransfer_DecryptPacketBlocks.

g_UiTransferSequenceToken: uint32_t sequence token stamped into outgoing network packets (initial 0x12340000, low 16 bits XORed with a random value in transfer.c; network/protocol/transfer.c, ui/frontend/network.c).
g_UiWindowMoveHandleWidth: int32_t, 19 (0x13): height in pixels of the top strip that drags a movable root window (src/ui/controls/layout.c).
g_UnreferencedArmyTag: char "ARMY" after the army0000.gfx string; no code reference found; followed by 0x90 fill
g_UnreferencedArmyTexturePathUtf16: UTF-16 L"army0000.gfx" after g_AiCommandGenerationRetainedTarget; no code reference found
g_UnreferencedCampaignPatternUtf16: UTF-16 L"level\\*.cgn"; no code reference found
g_UnreferencedLevelPatternUtf16: UTF-16 L"level\\*.lev" after the save pattern; no code reference found
g_UnreferencedSoftwareTextUtf16: uint16_t[9] L"Software" after the graphics hook table, followed by two NOP padding bytes; no code or data reference found.
g_Win32DriveDevicePathA: char[7]: "\\.\x:" device path of the unreachable IOCTL_STORAGE_CHECK_VERIFY probe in Win32Drive_CheckMediaReady (letter at [4]); followed by NOP fill up to FileSystem_Init
g_Win32DriveRootPathScratchA: char[4]: "x:\" root path, drive letter patched at [0] before GetDiskFreeSpaceA/GetVolumeInformationA/GetDriveTypeA; platform/filesystem/win32.c
k_SpatialSoundStereoCosineSecondHalfBase: Not an object: an address inside g_UiTransferEncryptSbox5 (+0x140) that the spatial-sound panning code uses as a biased base, 0x8000 * 8 bytes before g_FixedCosQ28, so base + azimuth * 8 reads g_FixedCosQ28[(azimuth - half turn) * 2]; its bytes are S-box data.
